title: Enable auto-apply after applying all recommendations

blocks.content: This step is optional. After you apply every recommendation for the current segment, Metrics can ask you to turn auto-apply on for that segment. Skip it when auto-apply is already on for that segment, because the prompt does not appear. Select an **Auto-apply mode**. These are the same modes as on Overview and in the segment edit dialog. To change the mode later, on **Segments** click **Edit segment** or **Edit default segment**. Overview does not list a segment that already has auto-apply on.

The prompt does not appear if you applied a selection of recommendations, or if auto-apply is already on for that segment.

1. On **Metrics**, click **Apply all recommendations**.
1. Select an **Auto-apply mode**.
1. Click **Enable auto-apply for this segment** to turn it on, or **Dismiss** to close the prompt.
1. If you dismiss it and do not want to see it again, select **Do not show this again** before you dismiss it.

To turn auto-apply off, on **Segments** click **Edit segment** or **Edit default segment**, then clear **Enable auto-apply**. The rules stay as they were applied at that moment. You can still change them yourself.
